newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks seen in rebound on Wall Street rally.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks seen in rebound on Wall Street rally.

text.p: Taiwan share prices were expected to open higher on Wednesday on technical rebounds of electronics boosted by Wall Street's overnight rally, brokers said.
Heavy profit-taking on electronic shares by regulators' public call for closer scrutiny of the sector's performance sent the stock index to a sharply lower close on Tuesday.
The benchmark stock index pushed as high as 9,877.39 in early Tuesday trade but sank to finish 283.37 points or 2.88 percent lower at 9,550.40.
A 9,550-9,700 range was seen for Wednesday.

"Selling pressure is expected to ease following Tuesday's fall, and there should be technical rebounds in major sectors including electronics, which plunged more than they should have," said Lei Pei-yu, analyst of Pacific Securities.
Brokers said Wall Street's and Nasdaq's sharp gains on Tuesday should encourage investors.
The Dow industrials surged 155 points to close at 8,062, while Nasdaq composite rebounded after recent round of profit-taking, jumping 8-3/16 to 144-1/8.
